newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-JACOBSEN'S LONGTIME CADDIE QUITS TO WORK FOR TIGER WOODS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-JACOBSEN'S LONGTIME CADDIE QUITS TO WORK FOR TIGER WOODS.

text.p: It's official. After 18 years, veteran caddie Mike "Fluff" Cowan has left Peter Jacobsen, ending one of the longest relationships on the PGA Tour to work for 20-year-old Tiger Woods.
Cowan told Jacobsen of his decision here at the Buick Challenge on Thursday.

Cowan has worked for Woods since the emerging superstar turned pro after winning a third consecutive U.S. amateur title one month ago. Jacobsen was idle until this week, and there was plenty of speculation as to whether Cowan would return to Jacobsen's bag next year.
Jacobsen, publicly at least, said he understood Cowan's decision. "Mike has an opportunity to work for probably the greatest thing to happen to golf in the last 20 years," he said.
Cowan, who left town after Woods withdrew from the tournament earlier this week, could not be contacted.
